subject.title: docs(reference): add Apple SpeechAnalyzer API knowledge-base page

question: Should OpenClaw's public reference documentation own a standalone Apple SpeechAnalyzer tutorial, or should this contribution be narrowed to how Swabble/OpenClaw specifically uses the API?
rationale: Both directions can be technically valid, but accepting this page establishes an ongoing documentation scope and ownership precedent that cannot be inferred safely from the existing product docs.

options.title: Narrow to OpenClaw usage
options.body: Replace the generic tutorial and standalone demo with concise Swabble-specific requirements, architecture, troubleshooting, and links to Apple's official documentation.

options.title: Approve the knowledge-base page
options.body: Explicitly accept ownership of the broader Apple API tutorial, then require a complete source audit and a passing documentation check before merge.

options.title: Close as out of scope
options.body: Decline the standalone knowledge-base surface and invite a fresh narrowly scoped Swabble documentation PR.

recommendation.title: Narrow to OpenClaw usage
recommendation.body: Replace the generic tutorial and standalone demo with concise Swabble-specific requirements, architecture, troubleshooting, and links to Apple's official documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository and package provenance most directly connects this owner to both Swabble and final documentation scope decisions.
